spanish: Y harás el atrio del mishkán; a lado sur hacia el sur, colgaduras al atrio lino fino torcido, cien en el codo largo al lado el uno.

findings.issue: Definite common noun left untranslated as mishkán; common nouns stay Spanish.
Morphology is a feminine cardinal, but the Spanish says fine linen and does not give the cardinal.
largo after codo can be read as an adjective on the cubit; ארך is a separate noun, length.

notes: Other tokens match: 2ms qal, court, both south terms, plural hangings, passive participle, hundred, and the one side.
